name: flashes-floaters-borderline
description: Borderline: spots the red flag and wants it seen today, but sends her to a same-day duty doctor call rather than an optometrist.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Good morning, is that the surgery? I'd like to book a routine appointment with the doctor, please.

transcript.speaker: trainee
transcript.text: Good morning, Pen-y-Bryn Surgery, Sam speaking. Who is calling please?

transcript.speaker: trainee
transcript.text: Thanks Delyth. Is it you who needs the appointment?

transcript.speaker: trainee
transcript.text: What is wrong with the eye?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I've been seeing flashing lights, and some black specks.

transcript.speaker: trainee
transcript.text: That doesn't sound like something that should wait. I'll ask the duty doctor to ring you back today.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Oh. Today? Right. Is that necessary?

transcript.speaker: trainee
transcript.text: Yes, I think it's best. They will call you this afternoon.

expect.flagsReason: She treated it as same-day urgent but chose a duty-doctor call, not the optometrist the key names, and the key lists no acceptable alternatives. Whether this counts as "acted on" and whether it is unsafe could be read either way, so none of the three flags is asserted.

greeting.reason: Own name, practice, caller name and for whom all done.

information.reason: Unlocked flashes, floaters, onset; did not ask which eye or about pain.

redFlag.reason: Recognised it needed same-day attention; acted, but not through the key's route.

destination.reason: Same-day urgent but not an optometrist; the key lists no alternatives. 1 for urgency right, 0 for the place wrong.

explanation.reason: Said when, little why, no safety net.
